revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_007
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 7, BLUE rank, FIRST medal in the blue pair. Based on the Chinese title concept "一人之力托举起9个小动物的奉献之神" (a devoted walking hero supporting many little animals). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot style as earlier candidates: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 7 pose: the foot mascot is heroically carrying a small stack of cute rounded paw-print charms or tiny pet token silhouettes on its back/arms, looking strained but proud. Keep the foot as the main character; the pet tokens are small supporting props only, with no text or numbers.
Medal border: BLUE rank, FIRST blue medal. Use a cobalt and sky-blue enamel circular ring with silver trim, small blue gems, small studs, and modest blue ornaments attached to the ring. IMPORTANT: no side wings, no feather wings, no large outward leaf wings, no big side fins. The silhouette must remain mostly circular with only small protrusions.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals and previous anthropomorphic foot candidates: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central foot mascot fully inside circular core. Base circle size consistent with previous tiers.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, heroic and funny.
Color palette: cobalt blue and sky blue border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, tiny pastel pet-token accents; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no wings, no feather wings, no external side wings, no large outward fins, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold; second medal of each color pair has wings
wing_rule: first medal in color pair has no wings
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
